description: S46 T8 (MG9/TD2): mcp.mine.proposeRevoke creates an INERT proposal to revoke a grant the CALLER currently holds — the pair is split in the request (server, tool) so a smuggled dot cannot forge a boundary, and the payload's agent field is the stamp, never the input: no proposal on this door can name another agent. An unheld pair and a pair nobody holds answer the same sentence; here the pair IS held, so the inert row is created.

params.reason: this loop never writes issues; the ask only slows it down

proposal.payload: {"agent":"implementer","qualified":"acme-crud.create_issue","reason":"this loop never writes issues; the ask only slows it down"}

result.note: the proposal is inert: it constrains nothing until a person commits it (S35 TD2)
